description: The chart represents a task taxonomy, comparing various categories within three main layers. The chart is divided into 17 slices, grouped into three main categories: Signal Layer, Semantic Layer, and Perception Layer. The slices are labeled with different task names, such as Audio Difference Analysis, Content Analysis, and Music Theory & Statistics, and are presented in varying shades of blue, with darker shades representing larger proportions. The three main layers are labeled and include percentage values: Signal Layer (4.3%), Semantic Layer (41.2%), and Perception Layer (40.4%), while the Cultural Layer is also labeled with a percentage (14.1%). Some slices are further divided into subcategories. The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are included inside the slices for the main categories. The segments appear to be ordered by their layer and size, with the largest slices in the Perception Layer and Semantic Layer.
